notes.title: Weekly Blog 7
notes.notes:
We’re revamping the UI!

With the Kickstarter coming up around the corner and having a lot of the gameplay mechanics polished, the team wanted to take some quality time and improve the UI, if you thought Gear Slayer was looking good before, you should check it out now!

Below are some Before vs After videos to give everyone a comparison

[h3]Core Conversion
[/h3]
Thanks to the feedback from the community, we realized how much the players appreciated the wheel concept for Core Conversion. Having the wheel set up this way helps us keep the game flow feel fluid and constantly moving.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/d8c1339eb669ddd086bbb3353e372e495478d9db.gif[/img]

[h3]Battle Priority and Attack
[/h3]
How gears initiate battle needed a lot of reworking, it become too clunky having to click your card, click across the screen to attack, so we want to keep everything centered around your card. With the new UI changes, you will see the “sword” icon above the cards ATK power. This icon indicates the card is ready to attack, now combat is only one-click away.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/50c195a6e87232b479366134ab457b4d53ca5410.gif[/img]

[h3]Expanded View
[/h3]
One of the most important changes we started with is the expanded view. Being able to look at your card from any stage in battle, and being able to read your card clearly. Players can now get a better idea of the cards they are selecting with the new version of the expanded view, or sit back and enjoy the amazing artwork on each card.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/e7fac2f4624ed0378c758a2131a59a4025d1d80c.gif[/img]

We’re not done with the UI, we are only getting started, some of the next items on our list for UI fixes are:

- Better player UI, with more details and clarity
- Card Stat UI: when a card is equipped or affected by another, a UI will appear next to it to show which card is linked to it.,
- A menu to resume, quit and turn on/off sound (not urgent but good for QOL)
- Revise the VFX and improving them to make them pop out more
- UI outside of battlefield (main menu, shop, collection, deck selection etc)

And, the most exciting changes - Adding more cards and the Prototype Deck

Kickstarter is coming up around the corner, we will be launching in early June so if you are not following the Kickstarter, now is the time to, don’t miss out on exclusive emotes and promo cards during the Kickstarter.

See you all next week

- Hybrid Theory Games

notes.title: Weekly Blog 6
notes.notes:
Welcome back to another weekly blog at Gear Slayer TCG!

This week, we’ve focused primarily on a few factors, such as power balancing, UI issues, and fine-tuning the specific mechanics involved for each keyword. 

We’ve also been refining the Kickstarter page by adding new GIFS and many new images, including the roadmap for Gear Slayer!

There’s been a ton of changes and improvements, so let’s dive in.

[h3]Let’s talk about Elemental Combat[/h3]

In Gear Slayer, there are 7 different elements you can fight with, each having its own weakness and resistance. This is why it’s crucial to keep a close eye on the elements in question, as your opponent can change yours or their element and resistance.

In the video, the opponent has turned my Aqua card into a Fire type, and with Bri being a water type, puts the opponent at an [b]elemental advantage[/b]. Cards with an elemental advantage will gain a +1 ATK buff during attack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/b1a852521a911daa0e7531986550c43ec30df9be.gif[/img]

[h3]Raine's Hazard & Attack Keyword
[/h3]

If you’ve ever noticed Raine has two icons on her card, which indicate two different keywords, these are:
[list]
[*] [b]Hazard:[/b] Plant 3 Venom Markers into your opponent’s Deck
[*] [b]Attack:[/b] If Venom Markers are in the opponent’s  Deck, the targeted gear loses 1ATK during combat.
[/list]
With the [b]Hazard Keyword[/b], you will place 3x Venom Markers into your opponent's deck whenever Raine is summoned onto the field. Now, this is where the twist comes with Raine's effect. 

The [b]Attack Keyword[/b] comes into effect only when that gear initiates an attack. 

So if Raine initiates an attack on an enemy card, as long as there are venom markers in their deck, the card Raine targets will lose a -1ATK. This can give Raine some serious firepower, especially if you keep placing Venom Markers onto your opponent's deck. This debuff might help turn the tide in battle.

Remember, not all [b]Attack keywords[/b] work the same way.
Some equip cards can give you the Attack Keyword, with a different effect.

[b]Raine and her Water Type Manipulators will be 1 of the 3 available decks on launch.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/638317278b7b37074bd50441a320c0f4f5b7815e.gif[/img]

[h3]Here’s The Gear Slayer Roadmap:[/h3]

It’s important for us to provide our community with a crystal-clear roadmap on where Gear Slayer is currently and where we want the IP to move in the next few years. Our amazing artist crafted this roadmap image for us to share on our Kickstarter page, and we wanted to share it here as well. 

We will have Gear Slayer TCG available for the public by Q3 2027.
Kickstarter backers will have Gear Slayer TCG by Q4 2026

Following up with the Private Beta Release, we will host our first online tournament!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/5f98946ea7916df8132c5663d6499761cd43943c.png[/img]

If you want to play Gear Slayer TCG, make sure you’re following along to back the campaign when we launch. There are a ton of benefits for those who participate in the Kickstarter campaign with us, including many exclusive skins. Promo cards will forever be locked away once the Kickstarter ends.

Make sure you’re following along so you don’t miss out

notes.title: Weekly Blog 5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is Rocco from Hybrid Theory Games. We have some exciting news regarding Gear Slayer's alpha. As we draw closer to the Kickstarter launch, we have been laser-focused on the QA for the alpha build, and we’ve made some insane improvements over the last couple of weeks. 

We want to begin showing off footage from the alpha with our community because we know how eager everyone is to start seeing gameplay footage. So, without further ado. 

Take a look at the progress the team has made recently!

[h1]Mulligan:[/h1]

Don’t like the cards you’re dealt with? No worries. Once the battle has started, both players will be allowed to select as many cards in their hands as they wish to swap out. The selected cards are shuffled back into your deck, allowing you to draw new cards. Giving players a chance at a stronger strategy from the beginning.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/8192b8a8da3a5e7c861cfeb71406ef12d2af0a90.gif[/img]

[h1]Discard Pile:[/h1]

Certain cards will allow you to play cards from your Discard Pile or your opponents’ discard pile, so it’s important to take the time and look through the Discard Pile before placing cards such as Crowe and Bri and make the best use of the Discard piles for your strategy.

Players can now look into, view and read the cards inside both Discard Piles and the Void Pile.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/f06293131f1c56a19c14ff5a9dd26cda82909839.gif[/img]

[h1]Crowe's Effect:
[/h1]

We want to give you a look at how card effects work, and use them to your advantage over your opponent. Since Crowe will be one of the first few cards most players will get familiar with, we decided to show you a great way to place additional venom markers on your opponent. Looking into your opponent's discard pile can give you an advantage with Crowe’s effect.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/b71055633ca070b5e6f378a59d3a8dd3795c65ae.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] Once Crowe is summoned, add 1 Utility card from either your Discard Pile or your opponent's Discard Pile to your hand. 

[*] If you select a card from the opponent's Discard Pile (not yours), you will plant 3x Venom Markers onto your opponent's deck. 

[*] Now, if you wait for your opponent to use a Venom Marker before summoning Crowe, you can place a total of 5x Venom Markers on your opponent's deck.
[/list]

All in one turn, all before you attack with Crowe.

[h1]Bonus: Gigantic Aria
[/h1]

During our QA journey for Gear Slayer, we encountered a gigantic (literally) bug in a previous version that we thought was hilarious and wanted to share. We were testing card interactions and accidentally created a Mega Aria card. Apparently, two cards decided they were better as one.

Aria decided being deadly wasn’t enough; she needed to be gigantic, too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/eb6e1d1d4ed8ba6670d333d652a80a10f738a9f6.gif[/img]

[h1]Thank you for the support, Slayers!
[/h1]

We are making excellent progress with the Kickstarter. In the following updates, we want to give a sneak peek into the Kickstarter trailer, provide additional gameplay footage, and help teach you how to play Gear Slayer so you can hit the ground running on a strong strategy with the Beta!

See you all next week!

Rocco
Hybrid Theory Games

notes.title: Weekly Blog 4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. It's Rocco from Hybrid Theory Games. We've got another epic announcement for voice actors we've brought in for the next wave of upcoming Hero cards.

[h1]Lucifer[/h1]

Lucifer the Onyx Blade - a powerful warrior and commander of the Hadian Empire's army. He acts as the right hand man of the king, and his loyalty is unbreakable. Known for swinging a large pitch black greatsword; capable of cleaving through waves of enemies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/0da39f0fcb8639acc3f59ae04672c9f7817db903.png[/img]

[h1]Adam[/h1]

Adam is the older brother of the twin duo from Allium's Project Origins experiment. Allium experiments with infusing high levels of Aura into children, raising them to be super soldiers. Adam is very crude, having little empathy for others. Being stoic and with a strong sense to follow through on his missions. He wields dual katanas and can use his Aura abilities to manifest a storm of aura-katanas capable to swarming armies. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/8c7d3f59221c5787889ed14eb1e0ae5c9d5f02f0.png[/img]

[h1]Eve
[/h1]

Eve is the younger sister of the twin duo. She is a brilliant yet sadistic strategist. She loves to see her enemies squirm as her plans unfold. Her analytical prowess makes her capable of adapting quickly to any situation while simultaneously planning her next set of moves. She can manifest aura crossbows that she can wield in-hand and also swarm her opponents similar to Adam's aura-katanas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/4451bd1247be6aec04521aef8b17bc252232aadf.png[/img]

Stay tuned for more updates surrounding voice acting, gameplay, and much more! 

If you haven't already, be sure to click "Notify me on launch" so you don't miss out - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hybridtheorygames/gear-slayer-tcg

notes.title: Weekly Blog 2
notes.notes:
Hey it's Rocco again with another weekly blog!

In today's update, we're showing you some of the VFX we've been producing over the past few weeks and are implementing into the Alpha of the game for the upcoming Kickstarter. 

Let's dive right in!

[b]Summon VFX[/b]
The idea behind the summon VFX is that the cards digitally manifest on the battlefield as if they are playing a combat simulator. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/4707b8a15cfcbf14a6fda8ddb50a1897ee9158ef.gif[/img]

[b]Ability Keyword VFX[/b]
This is an active keyword and activates after the Gear card is summoned, highlighted by that bright brimming aura and glow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/b27714231736c9ca3854627cf6ca412ecfd07bc2.gif[/img]

[b]Attack VFX
[/b]Emulating a battlefield - we wanted to design an attack VFX that emulates a powerful, and destructive impact, to really show the "clash" between two Gears on the field. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/bb074dc24d873773e5acd9874dc174051aad53df.gif[/img]

[b]Attack Up VFX[/b]
We utilized the upward movement of the aura and line-work to emulate the attack up buff. Pretty straightforward. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/87fcc92d943915bec178f4aa02d8839ef613f703.gif[/img]

[b]Attack Down[/b]
Similar to the Attack Up VFX, we utilized downward movement of the aura and line-work to emulate the attack up buff. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/f8c30e6bcff563f1a599c6c0793c88b10b5e7869.gif[/img]

[b]Zone Indicator
[/b]Here's a simple zone outline to highlight the Gear and Utility zones respectively from left to right.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/d4c07014a8d05293f4ae856a5b739182b5970f84.gif[/img]

[b]Player Turn Indicator VFX[/b]
Below are the turn indicators for P1 (blue) and your opponent (red).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/f2f96a9339ec846f4c799bc16e768a3b840b9e40.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/c525038a31607cb6efa805da9bc2485d150fe929.gif[/img]

We decided heavily on having scifi styled shards be utilized across our VFX and other visuals - think of it as our signature. 

Combining the digital shards with aura effects, we get the scifi-fantasy aesthetic and feel that fits the Gear Slayer identity. 

If you enjoyed these VFX, wait till you see what's in the works and what our team is adding in next, so stay tuned to the upcoming update, be sure to wishlist us Steam, follow our socials, join the discord community, and follow our Kickstarter!

Kickstarter: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hybridtheorygames/gear-slayer-tcg

notes.title: Weekly Blog 1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. It's Rocco from Hybrid Theory Games. In anticipation of our upcoming Kickstarter campaign, here is an update regarding voice acting for Gear Slayer TCG! 

We worked closely with the awesome voice actors at Closing Credits to find up and coming talent to voice some of our iconic heroes and cast - check out some of the voice actors and characters we've officially finished for adding in-game! 

[h1]Ultima[/h1]

Ultima is the protagonist of Gear Slayer and the world of Aurellia. Daughter of Cassandra and Erebus, and princess of the Hadian Empire - she is a talented fencer and fighter. Her life changes forever upon finding out her father's true identity and watching the horrifying tragedies unfold. Ultima flees the nation in the dead of night. Without a plan in mind - she fearfully runs for her life with the core objective of eventually taking back her homeland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/8f48938c440d280bde9179c0a39382b805b9413c.png[/img]

[h1]Raine [/h1]

Raine is the current Grandmaster of TORRENT, a mercenary and assassin organization within Darya. Being the daughter and granddaughter of the most ruthless Grandmasters, she wanted to change the way the organization was run. So over the years, she poisoned her father with the ideal of taking over the organization and ushering a new era for TORRENT. After her father's death, she received the signature dual blades possessed by a great demon and dragon that has been in her family for generations - when TORRENT was first established. The legend states that her ancestor killed a great demon and dragon and forced their souls into the swords to amass incredible power, at the cost of his humanity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/f064ac9d8ff1ac6fe7022fa4eff6c03d84b667a4.png[/img]

[h1]Leon
[/h1]

Regarded as the "Ogre", Leon is the strongest warrior of Belenus. He is known for his incredible brute strength and massive Aura. Leon is the leader of the Flamebreakers, Belenus' elite militia that fight against the Voids. Despite his kind and warm personality, he can instantly flip his switch when he needs to protect those around him. 

Equipped with his Shield Gauntlets, he can use his Fire Aura to conjure shields to absorb attacks and also use them as projectiles. 

His ultimate technique is his "Ogre Form", where he becomes and unstoppable force. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45466176/0e48b61b41193c829acf89ff019d4c616816b5ce.png[/img]


We have many more updates regarding voice acting on its way, featuring villains and a destructive sibling duo. Voice acting will be a core element to breathe life and personality into the cards you play, unveiling lore, special interactions and even easter eggs when certain cards are played together. 

Stay tuned for more updates surrounding voice acting, gameplay, and much more! 

If you haven't already, be sure to click "Notify me on launch" so you don't miss out - https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hybridtheorygames/gear-slayer-tcg
